Brief.title: Brief
Brief.description: Step 2: what exactly should be built (answers of the clarification dialog).

BuildingPart.title: BuildingPart
BuildingPart.description:
An OSM building:part inside the outline of a building (Simple 3D Buildings):
the outline is the object, its parts describe the shape in more detail.

CallCost.title: CallCost
CallCost.description:
One AI call as billed: the token counts the API reported, priced with the list
prices in ai/usage.py. `stage`/`item` are filled in by the job's cost book.

DesignEstimate.title: DesignEstimate
DesignEstimate.description: What a request to the AI architect may cost; shown before anything is sent.

ImageryInfo.title: ImageryInfo
ImageryInfo.description: Stored next to the image; also what the UI and the gates show.

ItemAttrs.title: ItemAttrs
ItemAttrs.description: Parameters for the generators (M3). All optional: unknown stays unknown.

ItemPatch.title: ItemPatch
ItemPatch.description: Editor changes; only the fields sent are applied.

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description: What the API returns: the job plus the approval currently waiting for the user.

LibraryPlacement.title: LibraryPlacement
LibraryPlacement.description: An object of the X-Plane library placed by a build script.

shareable.title: Shareable
shareable.description: May it go into a scenery package as a texture (see redistributable)?

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: A photo attached to a scene item (file: photos/<id>.jpg in the job folder).

PhotoCandidate.title: PhotoCandidate
PhotoCandidate.description: A search hit; only its id goes back to the client for thumbnails and import.

PhotoTexture.title: PhotoTexture
PhotoTexture.description:
A facade cut out of one of the item's photos (see build/phototex.py): the four
corners in the photo (fractions of its width/height, from the top left, in the
order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left) and its real size.

PlanObject.title: PlanObject
PlanObject.description: One 3D object of the plan, as generated for the preview.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: A question the analysis could not answer with confidence.

Research.title: Research
Research.description: What the research found out about an object (free sources, no AI).

Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description:
A free 3D scan of the object (Wikimedia Commons), reduced and stored with the
job (file relative to the job folder); built with scan() in the build script.

SimilarEstimate.title: SimilarEstimate
SimilarEstimate.description: What "find similar" would do; shown to the user before anything is sent.
